meta.brief: PRODUCT-ONLY escalation meme (NO person). Locked-off camera on the same bathroom counter. The number of LACALUT AKTIV tubes multiplies scene by scene — a neat few, then a growing pile, then an absurd overflowing mountain that starts to topple. Comedy = the absurd abundance. Caption + VO carry the 'never run out of the one that works' joke. Render-safe: personless, locked tripod, product only.
meta.note: MANY-TUBES concept: this ad intentionally shows duplicated tubes (the joke). At render time the product-fidelity 'never duplicate' lock must be relaxed for this ad; front tubes should stay readable, the deep pile can garble (acceptable comedy).

storyboard.hook: When you finally find the toothpaste you actually love…
storyboard.cta: Don't run out. Stock up — LACALUT AKTIV, the German original.
storyboard.voice: Male, warm, dry-comedic Australian accent — deadpan, builds with the absurdity.
storyboard.product: the LACALUT AKTIV tube — REAL GERMAN pack (German label exactly as the reference packshot), WHITE cap, tall slim proportions. EVERY sharp/front tube must be this identical German pack — NEVER a fabricated or English-language tube; only distant, blurred tubes deep in the pile may soften. Many identical German tubes fill the frame as the ad escalates.
storyboard.world: A clean, warm home bathroom counter with a white ceramic sink and soft morning daylight. Locked-off tripod framing on the counter — the SAME framing every scene, only the quantity of tubes changes.
storyboard.styleAnchor: Clean, bright, slightly comedic product-shot look — crisp daylight, shallow-ish depth, satisfying and absurd, like a viral 'how it started vs how it's going' product reel.

scenes.visual: Locked-off shot of the bathroom counter. FOUR IDENTICAL LACALUT AKTIV tubes (same red-white pack) stand in a tidy, evenly-spaced row beside the sink, all front labels facing camera, crisp and readable. Clean, calm, ordinary. The tubes are perfectly still.
scenes.motion: Camera LOCKED OFF on a tripod, completely still. The tubes DO NOT move at all — no popping in, no sliding, no bouncing. The ONLY motion is a soft, gentle drift of morning light across the scene. Keep all four German AKTIV packs perfectly still, front-facing and razor-sharp the entire clip (still labels = no garble). The 'How it starts…' caption is added in post.
scenes.vo: When you finally find the toothpaste you actually love… you don't take chances.

scenes.visual: Hard cut. Same locked-off counter, now MORE tubes — about EIGHT IDENTICAL LACALUT AKTIV tubes (same red-white pack) all STANDING UPRIGHT directly on the counter surface in a wide, evenly-spaced double row across the bench (like bottles lined up on a shelf). CRITICAL: every tube stands on its own base on the flat counter — NONE is stacked, leaned or resting on top of another, so nothing can topple. Tubes are spaced apart so each label is clearly separate and legible. Front tubes tack-sharp, labels to camera. Perfectly still.
scenes.motion: Hard cut to more upright tubes (escalation is the CUT, not motion). Camera LOCKED OFF, completely still — a frozen still-life. The tubes are a STABLE row standing flat on the counter: nothing falls, tumbles, leans, slides or collapses (there is no stack to fall). Only a faint drift of light moves. Keep every tube upright, separated and razor-sharp so no two labels blend.
scenes.vo: So you stock up. Then you stock up again.

scenes.visual: Hard cut. Same counter, now COVERED in tubes — around SIXTEEN IDENTICAL LACALUT AKTIV tubes (same red-white pack) all STANDING UPRIGHT directly on the counter surface, packed in neat rows filling the whole bench edge to edge (like a fully-stocked shop shelf). CRITICAL: every tube stands on its own base on the flat surface — NONE stacked, leaned or on top of another, nothing can topple. ONE hero tube razor-sharp and label-forward in the near foreground; the rows behind recede in soft depth of field. Comedically many, but orderly and stable. Completely still.
scenes.motion: Hard cut to the counter packed with upright tubes (escalation is the CUT, not motion). Camera LOCKED OFF, framed a touch wider, completely still — a frozen comedic still-life like a stocked shelf. NOTHING tumbles, leans, slides, rolls or collapses (there is no stack to fall). Only a soft drift of light. The one front hero tube stays crisp, readable and separated; the rows behind stay soft with depth so no two labels blend or garble.
scenes.vo: Because running out? Not an option. LACALUT Aktiv — German gum care. Fluoride. Hydroxyapatite.
